```yaml
name: CI (ARM64)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-python-arm64:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ruby-version: ['3.3']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Python dependencies for tests
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pipenv poetry

      - name: Run Python Dependency Grapher Tests
        run: |
          bundle exec rspec python/spec/dependabot/python/pipenv_dependency_grapher_spec.rb \
                           python/spec/dependabot/python/dependency_grapher_spec.rb \
                           --format documentation

      - name: Run Full Python Suite (ARM64)
        run: |
          bundle exec rspec python/spec --tag ~slow --format progress
```
